train_mlp_vae: train an MLP VAE on data using get_mlp_vae_encoder_decoder with a custom MLPVAEConfig
create_vae_enn: create an ENN from encoder and decoder functions using make_vae_enn with a latent dimension
train_custom_vae: train a custom VAE with encoder and decoder using train_vae with a specified optimizer and loss function
configure_mlp_vae: configure an MLP VAE with hidden sizes, latent dimension, and learning rate using MLPVAEConfig
encode_decode_latent: encode data to latent space and decode back using the TrainedVAE encoder and decoder functions
